verdict.rationale: The only refund-relevant evidence is a single line about the batch-settlement scheme stating that 'buyers retain defined refund and withdrawal semantics,' but this is not elaborated into an actual API, dashboard, or programmatic tracking mechanism, and no other docs address refunds/disputes for standard (non-batch) x402 payments. missing for 10: a documented refund API or endpoint, dispute-resolution workflow, refund status tracking, and coverage for non-batch payment flows.
